title: Cut 2 folded into the execution cut
situation: Cut 2's remaining round (0015, 0024) was planned on the canon role system the catalog re-cut retired: role text reduced to concepts is done by the re-cut; the example inventory and the builder-aware commit guard are the work package capability's; its branch, feature/workflow-execution, builds on retired pieces and the replaced design files.
decision: Cut 2 does not resume as a cut of its own. Its structural examples join the execution cut (0055); its behavioral examples (5, 8, 10, 11, 12) become evaluations of the composed roles' behavior in that cut. feature/workflow-execution is not merged; its work package code is adopted only if an assay finds it realizes the concepts (0013), otherwise rebuilt.
consequences: 0024 is superseded; the branch is kept until the execution cut decides adoption, then deleted.
